data.shortcut_sources: Add volume and channel shortcuts to the TV inputs (for Siri)

data_description.volume_steps: How many steps the Volume up and Volume down buttons change the volume each time they are pressed.
data_description.shortcut_sources: Adds Volume up, Volume down, Next channel and Previous channel to the TV's input list. HomeKit gives Siri no volume or channel control for TVs, only switching inputs; choosing one of these in Apple Home (or asking Siri to switch the TV to it) runs the action instead of changing the input.
